# suedeMarket

> suedeMarket is a marketplace for musical instruments, gear, and audio software, built to be used by people and by software agents through the same catalog.

- Publisher: Suede Labs AI (https://suedeai.ai)
- Creator: Jason Colapietro (also known as Johnny Suede)
- Canonical URL: https://market.suedeai.ai
- Part of the Suede Labs AI ecosystem

## Status

suedeMarket is early. Seller accounts are open and the catalog is still filling,
so a browse page may legitimately return no results. Listing counts, transaction
volumes, and comparable figures are deliberately not published anywhere on this
site, because there are no meaningful ones to report yet.

## What suedeMarket does

- List instruments, gear, and audio software for sale, with condition and price
- Search and filter the catalog by category, condition, and price
- Make, counter, accept, and withdraw offers on a listing
- Message the other side of a deal in a thread attached to the listing
- Track an order through confirmed, shipped, delivered, and completed
- Leave and read reviews on a completed order
- Issue API keys and drive all of the above from an agent over MCP

## What suedeMarket does not do

- It does not process payments, hold funds, or provide escrow
- It does not issue invoices or handle tax
- It is not a licensing authority: software licenses are transferred between
  buyer and seller on the terms stated in the listing, and suedeMarket is not
  an agent of, or partnered with, any software developer whose products are
  listed on it

## Agent access

- MCP endpoint: https://market.suedeai.ai/api/mcp (requires an API key)
- REST endpoints under https://market.suedeai.ai/api for listings, offers,
  orders, conversations, profiles, and reviews
- API keys are created from the account dashboard after registering

## Key pages

- Home: https://market.suedeai.ai
- Browse the catalog: https://market.suedeai.ai/listings
- Create an account: https://market.suedeai.ai/register
